name: Clippy
description: The last things you copied, to copy again with a click. Kept in memory only, never on disk.
author: Giuseppe
details: A short memory for the things you copy. Clippy keeps the last ten texts, images and files, and copies any of them again with a click. It never writes them to disk and forgets everything when Notcholino quits; what password managers mark as secret is never kept.
features: The last 10 copies: text, images, files
In memory only, never on disk
Skips what password managers mark as secret
permissions: Reads the clipboard. No permission needed.
